description:
£130 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to welcome to the student lettings market this well proportioned three bedroom ground floor flat on the ever popular Tavistock Road, in the heart of West Jesmond.

Ideally located for student living, the property offers excellent access to the wider Jesmond area, with West Jesmond Metro Station, local pubs, cafés and everyday amenities all within easy reach.

The flat comprises three spacious double bedrooms and an open-plan living room and kitchen, creating a practical and sociable living space. Further benefits include double glazing throughout, a private rear yard and a carport, providing valuable outdoor space and parking. Combining generous accommodation with a sought-after location, this property is an excellent choice for students looking to make the most of everything Jesmond has to offer.

To arrange your viewing, contact My Property Box today and speak to our Lettings Team.
